summary: Phase 24 (VEDA hardening) end-to-end testing complete. Backend 24/24 NEW Phase-24 tests PASS + 65/65 Phase-1/2/3 regression PASS (cumulative 89/89). Frontend /veda-console renders all 3 tabs (Intent / Voice / KB). Intent: keyword classification (fees/fee_due/keyword/0.65), catalog (8 categories, 61 intents), LLM fallback path, recent classifications list — all working. Voice: hi-language selectable, invalid .png upload returns 422 with toast 'audio extension must be one of [...]'. KB: 4 KPI cards (3/3/0/8), only_pending toggle, ingestion run history (incremental run shows 0 src / 0 chunks after full run). Role-gating verified: student sidebar entry hidden, direct nav loads page, kb-run-btn returns 403 'Admin / governance required' toast. Multi-role chat API works (persona=admin/student/parent inferred + RAG grounding + Telugu language passthrough).

issues: voice-recent-list data-testid is attached to the ItemList component; when the items array is empty, the ItemList renders the empty-state ('Nothing here yet.') without exposing the data-testid root, so a strict query_selector for [data-testid=voice-recent-list] returns null while voice-recent-panel renders correctly. Cosmetic only — the panel itself is visible per spec requirement.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Ensure data-testid='voice-recent-list' renders on the wrapper even when items=[] so empty-state can be asserted directly by tests.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_phase24_veda.py is clean — Pydantic validation (Field constraints on text length, language enum, audio extension whitelist), tenant guard on every route, role-gating on writes (kb/ingest-run = admin/governance, voice/transcribe write allowed broadly per spec), _id excluded from Mongo reads, intent classifier uses word-boundary regex with optional s/es plural (catches 'exam dates' for 'exam date' keyword, avoids matching 'fee' inside 'feeling'). LLM fallback path degrades gracefully to method='fallback' when Claude returns invalid JSON or unknown category. KB ingestion is idempotent — second run with only_pending=True correctly processes 0 sources.

routes_ai.py assistant/message: persona inference from user.role with explicit role_override support is backward-compatible. Multilingual passthrough (en/hi/te/ar) preserved in response. RAG grounding falls back to 'faq' when no approved content_sources exist for the tenant — test accepts both 'rag' and 'faq' which is correct.
ai_service.py chat_send max_history=20 rolling cap is implemented correctly — prevents unbounded message history accumulation.

/veda-console route intentionally not route-protected on the frontend (consistent with Phase 1/2/3 closeout pattern); only sidebar visibility + write API role-gating enforce access — confirmed by design note from main agent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 24 closeout (iteration_24) green. Cumulative regression suite: phase21 (29) + phase22 (20) + phase23 (16) + phase24 (24) = 89 tests, all PASS. Set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest. The intent classifier persists logs with unique uuid tokens so re-runs accumulate but stay bounded. Voice 422 paths are the only tested voice flow — Whisper live transcription was not exercised (per agent context). KB ingestion uses content_sources table — after full run, all sources are flagged 'ingested', so incremental runs are 0/0.
